name: Pinal 675 Weekly Regional
preamble:
Introduction 

Good evening, everybody, this is [YOUR NAME AND CALLSIGN], your net control operator tonight for the Southwest Regional GMRS Net for the Pinal 675 repeater. This net gathers every Sunday at 5 PM Arizona time.

This net has been hosted by the members of the Southwest Community Radio System and is open to all licensed operators. SWCRS is a volunteer and member supported radio community. 

This is a directed net. If you have any comments or responses, please call for net control first, do not directly address other stations except as directed by net control. The net control operator will coordinate all traffic. If you have any emergency or priority traffic, break-in at any time.

[CALL FOR EMERGENCY TRAFFIC]

Opening Announcements

Check-In

We will now begin check-in, which is in alphabetical order by callsign. If you miss your turn, we will follow with a call for late or missed check-ins at the end of the roll. If you have any comments for tonight’s topic, please give them when called and try to keep your response to 30 seconds or less. New check ins will be called later on the net, so please be patient. 

We will now begin the roll call:

name: TAZ 625 Thursday Night Net
preamble:
Evening Greetings, this is WRNR761, Andrew, I am activating the weekly Thursday night net and will serve as net control. This net meets every Thursday at 7 PM and is open to all licensed GMRS operators.

If you are new and have never checked in with this net please wait until the open check-in portion of the NET. This is a directed net - all traffic should go through the net control. At any time during this net, if there is any priority or emergency traffic, we will stop the net until that traffic is concluded. Is there is any priority or emergency traffic that needs to use the frequency, if so, please call now (Pause for anyone that may need the repeater). Having heard nothing, we will continue with the net.

 

Topic of Discussion:

           This evening’s discussion topic is:

Trivia:

Roll Call:

           We will now begin the roll call. Upon hearing your callsign please acknowledge and let us know whether you have any comments on the discussion topic by stating, comment.

Call out each call sign on the list and note whether they have comments for the discussion

Open check-ins. If anyone that was not on the roll call who would like to participate in the net, please give your call sign now. 

Record any new call signs and whether they have comments for the discussion topic


General Announcements:

           That concludes the roll call. Before we begin the discussion, if there is anyone that has a general announcement for the group, please give your call sign now.

Open the net to anyone that has announcements and record them in the notes.

Discussion:

      We will now begin the round table on our discussion topic. Don’t forget to also include your answer to the trivia question.

Start at the top of the check-in roster and call out each call sign to have them give their comments on the discussion topic. Record comments from the operators in the comment section of the check-in sheet.

Late Check-ins:  

  If there are any late or missed check-ins and you would like to participate in the discussion, please give your callsign now.

Trivia Question Answers:

  The correct answer for this evening’s trivia question was…. Congratulations to call out all call signs that answered correctly for correctly answering this afternoon’s trivia question.

What’s up in Radio: Does anyone have an experience in radio that you would like to share? Something you did or learned this past week? Say your call sign and wait to be recognized before sharing.
closing:
Conclusion:

           This concludes the TAZ 625 Thursday night GMRS Net. If you have an idea for future discussion topics or trivia questions, please email your suggestions to WRNR761@pm.me. 

This evening, we had a total of ____check-ins; thank you to all who participated in the discussion. We will be here next Thursday at 7 PM. This is “your call sign, your name”, and I am closing out this NET and returning the repeater to their normal operation and wishing everyone a great evening.
